newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - East Rochester USD, N.Y..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - East Rochester USD, N.Y..

text.p: EAST ROCHESTER UNION FREE SCHOOL DISTRICT

Sealed proposals will be received and considered by the undersigned President of the Board of Education of East Rochester Union Free School District, Monroe County, New York, at the Office of Willkie Farr & Gallagher, 900 Third Avenue, 17th Floor, New York, New York 10022, until 11:30 o'clock A.M., Prevailing Time, on the

at which time and place the bids will be opened, for the purchase INFEDERALFUNDS at not less than par and accrued interest of $1,200,000 School District (Serial) Bonds, 1997, of said School District, dated April 15, 1997, and maturing in annual principal installments which, together with

interest thereon, are expected to provide for substantially level or declining annual debt service on such bonds, as defined and described in paragraph d of Section 21.00 of the New York Local Finance Law as follows: $45,000 on June 15, 1998, $55,000 on June 15, 1999, $60,000 on June 15 2000, $65,000 on June 15 in each of the years 2001 and 2002, $70,000 on June 15, 2003, $75,000 on June 15, 2004, $80,000 on June 15, 2005, $85,000 on June 15 in each of the years 2006 and 2007, $90,000 on June 15, 2008, $100,000 on June 15 in each of the years 2009 and 2010, $110,000 on June 15, 2001, and $115,000 on June 15, 2012, with interest thereon payable December 15, 1997 and semi-annually thereafter on June 15 and December 15. THE SCHOOL DISTRICT RESERVES THE RIGHT TO CHANGE THE TIME AND/OR DATE FOR THE OPENING OF BIDS. NOTICE OF ANY SUCH CHANGE SHALL BE PROVIDED NOT LESS THAN 48 HOURS PRIOR TO THE TIME SET FORTH ABOVE FOR THE OPENING OF BIDS BY MEANS OF A SUPPLEMENTAL NOTICE OF SALE TO BE TRANSMITTED OVER THE MUNIFACTS WIRE. Bonds maturing on or before June 15, 2006 are not subject to redemption prior to maturity. Bonds maturing on June 15, 2007 and thereafter are subject to redemption, at the option of the School District, prior to maturity, in whole or in part, in inverse order of maturity or in equal proportionate amounts, on any interest payment date on or after June 15, 2006, at redemption prices, expressed as a percentage of par as follows: June 15, 2006 and December 15, 2006, 102%; June 15, 2007 and December 15, 2007, 101%; and June 15, 2008 and thereafter, 100%. Each bid, accompanied by a $24,000 good faith check, must be for all of said $1,200,000 bonds. Unless all bids are rejected the award will be made to the bidder complying with the terms of the complete Notice of Sale and offering to
purchase said bonds at such rate or rates of interes will produce the lowest net interest cost. The purchaser will be furnished without cost, the

unqualified legal opinion as to the validity of the Bonds of Willkie Farr & Gallagher, New York, New York, Bond Counsel. For further information regarding the Bonds and to obtain copies of the complete Notice of Bond Sale, Bid Form, and the Preliminary Official Statement of the School District, please contact Fiscal Advisors & Marketing, Inc., telephone: (315) 699-7912, telecopier: (315) 699-8833. Additional
Official Statements may be downloaded from Fiscal Advisors & Marketing, Inc.'s Internet address:
